summary: The fund seeks to track the investment results of the S&P Global 1200 Information Technology 4.5/22.5/45 Capped IndexTM, which is designed to measure the performance of global equities in the information technology sector. The underlying index is a subset of the S&P Global 1200, which is designed to measure the performance of large-capitalization stocks from major global markets, as determined by S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC (the “index provider” or “SPDJI”). It is non-diversified.
